All five h300 objectives and best bounds coincide; their original warehouse, flow, inventory and shortage CSVs are byte-identical across arms. Native Runtime ranges from 47.14 to 67.61 minutes and sampled application RSS from 46.35 to 78.37 GiB. This establishes identical exported vectors in this block, not a unique optimum.

Its ability to display a flow requires original positive-flow evidence and source-bound road geometry. Geography alone is not a validation of the agricultural plan.
